    public static Tensor tensor(int[][][][][][] values, TensorOptions options) {
        if (values == null) throw new NullPointerException("values");
        if (options == null) throw new NullPointerException("options");
        IntVectorVectorVectorVectorVectorVector outer = new IntVectorVectorVectorVectorVectorVector((long)values.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
            int[][][][][] sub0 = values[i];
            if (sub0 == null) throw new NullPointerException("values[" + i + "]");
            IntVectorVectorVectorVectorVector mid0 = new IntVectorVectorVectorVectorVector((long)sub0.length);
            for (int j = 0; j < sub0.length; j++) {
                int[][][][] sub1 = sub0[j];
                if (sub1 == null) throw new NullPointerException("values[" + i + "][" + j + "]");
                IntVectorVectorVectorVector mid1 = new IntVectorVectorVectorVector((long)sub1.length);
                for (int k = 0; k < sub1.length; k++) {
                    int[][][] sub2 = sub1[k];
                    if (sub2 == null) throw new NullPointerException("values[" + i + "][" + j + "][" + k + "]");
                    IntVectorVectorVector mid2 = new IntVectorVectorVector((long)sub2.length);
                    for (int l = 0; l < sub2.length; l++) {
                        int[][] sub3 = sub2[l];
                        if (sub3 == null) throw new NullPointerException("values[" + i + "][" + j + "][" + k + "][" + l + "]");
                        IntVectorVector mid3 = new IntVectorVector((long)sub3.length);
                        for (int m = 0; m < sub3.length; m++) {
                            int[] row = sub3[m];
                            if (row == null) throw new NullPointerException("values[" + i + "][" + j + "][" + k + "][" + l + "][" + m + "]");
                            mid3.put((long)m, new IntVector(row));
                        }
                        mid2.put((long)l, mid3);
                    }
                    mid1.put((long)k, mid2);
                }
                mid0.put((long)j, mid1);
            }
            outer.put((long)i, mid0);
        }
        return tensor_md_6d_int32_opt(outer, options);
    }
